fields.summary_ko.0: Visa stock declined 2.3% in after-hours trading despite Q4 results (adjusted EPS of $3.48 exceeding consensus of $3.44, revenue of $12.1B exceeding $12.09B) due to weak 2027 guidance (adjusted EPS growth expected to be single-digit to low-double-digit).
fields.summary_ko.1: On a fiscal-year basis, revenue grew 15% to $45.9B and adjusted EPS grew 16% to $13.27, but 2027 guidance reflecting deceleration from 2026 (adjusted EPS growth of 16%) raised investor concerns.
